item.title: Virgin Media O2 to cut thousands of jobs in cost shake-up
item.body: The telecoms company (VMO2) is to cut thousands of jobs as it reduces its cost base. The move comes amid investor concerns about its ability to service its £22bn debt.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 📉 Virgin Media O2 to cut thousands of jobs in cost shake-up

The telecoms company (VMO2) is to cut thousands of jobs as it reduces its cost base. The move comes amid investor concerns about its ability to service its £22bn debt.

Source: Sky News | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 31 October, 10:50
